report.summary: The cause was in `public/src/retry.js`. `withRetry` gave up early whenever a retry (not the first attempt) also got a 503. The comment said an overloaded server shouldn't get more load. In the incident the health endpoint kept answering 503, so the panel showed "Service health unavailable" after about 1 second instead of the 1, 2 and 4 second retries HLT-2 requires. I removed that shortcut, so a failed read is now retried up to three times after 1, 2 and 4 seconds. The panel shows the services as soon as a retry succeeds. After the last failure it shows the unavailable message with the Retry button, as before. `withRetry` is only used by the health panel, so nothing else changes. I also added a regression test in `test/board.test.js` for repeated 503s followed by a success.
report.verification: `npm test` passes (5 of 5, including the new test). The new test fails if the 503 shortcut is put back. I did not drive the page in a browser against a 503-returning server.
